files.note: Upper south-east corner during an Oct 2015 game at dusk, looking across to the west stands and press box with the mountains behind; field rows ~880-1350 of 1350 (65-100%), west stands rows ~470-880, dramatic sky top ~35%. Field sits low: needs a strong downward offset. Taken just before the 2016 seating/premium renovation
